title: ORBITALIF: An Efficient Spiking Federated Learning Framework for Onboard Cloud Removal
abstract: arXiv:2608.24073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-earth-orbit (LEO) satellites enable high-resolution, large-scale Earth observation for applications such as disaster monitoring and environmental surveillance. However, cloud coverage often obscures the Earth's surface, and conventional cloud-removal pipelines that download cloudy images to ground stations for processing suffer from limited contact windows, constrained satellite-to-ground bandwidth, and high latency. In this work, we propose a novel satellite federated learning framework for cloud removal across LEO constellations, named orbital attention leaky integrate-and-fire (OrbitALIF). OrbitALIF performs both onboard training and inference using a compact 2.30,M-parameter spiking neural network (SNN) backbone with an adaptive gated fusion module (AGFM) and a spectral-spatial hybrid attention module (SHAM), combined with a decentralized federated learning strategy that shares model weights via inter-satellite links. translated_title: ORBITALIF：一种用于星上云移除的高效脉冲联邦学习框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24073v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：低地球轨道（LEO）卫星能够实现高分辨率、大规模的地球观测，用于灾害监测和环境监视等应用。然而，云层经常遮挡地球表面，传统的云移除流程需要将含云图像下载到地面站进行处理，但这种方式受限于有限的接触窗口、受限的星地带宽和高延迟。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的卫星联邦学习框架，用于LEO星座间的云移除，名为轨道注意力泄漏整合发放（OrbitALIF）。OrbitALIF使用一个紧凑的2.30百万参数脉冲神经网络（SNN）主干，结合自适应门控融合模块（AGFM）和光谱-空间混合注意力模块（SHAM），执行星上训练和推理，并采用去中心化的联邦学习策略，通过星间链路共享模型权重。我们的实验...
tldr: 本文提出了OrbitALIF，一种基于紧凑脉冲神经网络和去中心化联邦学习的卫星星上云移除框架，通过星间权重共享实现高效、低延迟的云移除。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OrbitALIF, an efficient onboard cloud removal framework for LEO satellites using a compact spiking neural network and decentralized federated learning with inter-satellite weight sharing.
